prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: standalone website thumbnail for a generic smoke-and-dust scene category, an observation illustration only.
Primary request: a natural daylight photograph of the outskirts of a contemporary Chinese city, with gently uneven grassy terrain, low shrubs and a woodland edge in the middle distance. A single modest wisp of pale gray-white smoke rises from a distant point near ground level, becoming thin and diffuse in the air. The exact source of the smoke is not shown. The setting should read as an ordinary inspection observation, with a few subdued distant city buildings or rural structures near the horizon.
Composition/framing: horizontal image approximately 1000 by 680 pixels, aspect ratio 1.47:1. Medium-wide slightly elevated oblique view, enough terrain and vegetation around the smoke to give context. The smoke is clearly visible but small relative to the environment, naturally backlit or side-lit, not a thick dramatic plume. No close-up flames or people.
Style/medium: realistic professional outdoor documentary photography, ordinary bright daylight, plausible atmospheric depth, natural foliage texture and soft sky, restrained saturation, no cinematic disaster aesthetic, no illustration or 3D look.
Constraints: no visible explosion, no exaggerated wildfire or industrial disaster, no endangered people, no drones, no flames as a primary subject. No numerical readouts, instrument displays, density scales, detection boxes, labels, graphics, user interface, annotations, text, branding or watermarks. The image must not imply a confirmed fire incident, quantified smoke concentration, environmental diagnosis, or actual model output.
limitations: AI-generated generic smoke observation illustration; not a customer case, confirmed fire incident, quantified smoke concentration, pollution determination or model output. Parent owns visual review and website crop verification.
